reading_note: The teaching anatomizes the ruling love of self (King of Darkness) by enumerating five modes of its expression in ultimates, each corresponding to a discrete degree of falsity-from-evil (lion/fire = burning malice; eagle/wind = soaring conceit; demons/smoke = obscuring deceit; dragon-belly/darkness = devouring greed; fish-loins/water = sensual falsity). The arc moves from the form of self-love, to its powers of shape-shifting through these modes, to three triads describing its inner character: (1) it conceals/reveals its lower affections to destroy them and is impenetrable because it was molded out of the proprium of evil itself; (2) it alternates between fiery zeal and cold indifference and scrutinizes the heart of every subordinate falsity; (3) it has no real life — its life is bile, the poison of its own malice. The teaching reveals the structure of regnant self-love as it appears when fully formed in the natural mind.
